body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and Suburban Directory for 1877.
A copy of the full directory is held by Melbourne History Resources, and you can read it online.

The 1877 directory has its own Carlton section, under North Melbourne (pp. 61–78), covering the area east of the Elizabeth-street extension between Victoria-street east and Park-street, as far east as Nicholson-street, including the streets it marks "N Carlton" and the Royal Park, Sydney-road and Flemington-road entries. It lists the streets alphabetically, each house by house with the cross streets in order. All of the section is included here. Rathdowne, Berkeley and Neil (or Neild) streets are stored as Rathdown, Berkley and Neill streets to match the later years.
